meta.title: Three Marks modpack — download the manager
meta.description: A free Mir Tankov modpack: marks in battle, damage log, session stats, a replay manager and dozens more components. Your own data only, fair play by design, no ads.

hero.title: Three Marks modpack
hero.lead: Your marks percentage right in battle, a damage log, session stats in the hangar and a replay manager — {count} components that work only with your own data. One app installs and updates them.
hero.preparing: The first release is on its way — the button works as soon as the files are on the server.

trust.label: Why you can trust the modpack

fairPlay.title: Fair play
fairPlay.text: Nothing about enemies beyond what the client shows: no enemy reloads, no aiming help.

free.title: Free, no ads
free.text: Every component is free. The modpack does not need a Plus subscription.

lestaId.title: No passwords
lestaId.text: We never ask for your game password: you sign in to the site with Lesta ID, and the mod binds with a one-time code.

control.title: Everything switches off
control.text: Each component turns on separately, and the manager takes a backup before every update.

showcase.title: What's inside
showcase.lead: {count} components in five sections. The core, the companion and the settings window always come along; the rest is your pick.
showcase.legend: “Default” means the component is in the “Recommended” set the manager offers first.

battle.title: Battle
battle.lead: Battle interface panels: your damage, your hits and what the client already shows.

hangar.title: Hangar
hangar.lead: Hangar conveniences that save clicks between battles.

marks.title: Marks and stats
marks.lead: Everything about marks and your form — in battle, in the hangar and on the site.

replays.title: Replays
replays.lead: Your replays in the mod window and on the site.

streamers.title: For streamers
streamers.lead: Streamer mode, a clock and records. The manager has a ready-made “Streamer” set with the panels viewers like to see.

damage_log.title: Damage log
damage_log.text: Dealt, blocked and assisted damage with the shell type, plus a “last hit” pop-up.

hit_log.title: Hit log
hit_log.text: Your hits: the target, the damage and the HP it has left.

received_hits.title: Hits on you
received_hits.text: Who fired, which shell and how it ended: penetration, crit, no penetration or ricochet.

team_hp.title: Team HP and score
team_hp.text: Total team HP and the score in place of the stock strip, optionally a bar per tank.

sixth_sense.title: Sixth sense lamp
sixth_sense.text: A big icon and a sound when the skill fires. Replaces the stock lamp.

reload_timer.title: Gun reload
reload_timer.text: Your own gun's reload countdown with a bar, and the shells left in the clip.

battle_loadout.title: Equipment in battle
battle_loadout.text: The game's own equipment and directive icons above the shell bar, no labels, with a tooltip on hover.

gun_arc.title: Gun traverse
gun_arc.text: How many degrees your gun still turns left and right. Only on vehicles with limited traverse.

death_card.title: Death card
death_card.text: Who finished you, with what and for how much, and which modules and crew were hit.

bush_circle.title: 15 m circle
bush_circle.text: A circle on the ground: move further from the bush and your shot gives you away. On a key or always.

arty_meter.title: Artillery meter
arty_meter.text: How much artillery hit you: direct hits, splashes, stuns and damage, per battle and per day.

platoon_points.title: Platoon points
platoon_points.text: Points like in a platoon tournament: for damage, assist, kills and survival, by your own rules.

crosshair.title: Crosshairs
crosshair.text: Presets of the stock reticle, the server reticle and 20 centre markers to pick from.

camera.title: Zoom and camera
camera.text: Camera presets, sniper zoom and stabilisation — the game's own settings in one click.

minimap.title: Minimap
minimap.text: Size, opacity, vehicle labels and your view circles — only what the game's settings offer.

hud_layouts.title: Layout per battle type
hud_layouts.text: Its own panels for random battles, Onslaught, Frontline and events. Switches by itself.

chat_filter.title: Chat filter
chat_filter.text: Timestamps on messages; hides repeats, flood, command spam and the words you pick.

battle_sounds.title: Event sounds
battle_sounds.text: Your own sounds for fire, crits, crew stun, first blood and kills. Needs a sound mod with Wwise events.

hangar_tweaks.title: Hangar tweaks
hangar_tweaks.text: A one- or two-row carousel and quick actions: demount equipment and the style, crew to barracks.

hangar_info.title: Clock and server
hangar_info.text: Time, server, ping and online in the hangar corner, crew XP to the next skill.

hangar_cleaner.title: Clean hangar
hangar_cleaner.text: No promo teaser and no offer banners.

notification_filter.title: Notification filter
notification_filter.text: Hides ads, sales and auctions in the notification centre.

auto_resupply.title: Auto-resupply
auto_resupply.text: Repairs, shells, consumables and directives with one button — for a tank or the whole hangar.

battle_hits.title: Battle wounds
battle_hits.text: Where you were hit: a tank diagram with the hits and a list of side, result and damage.

personal_missions.title: Personal missions helper
personal_missions.text: The conditions of your active missions, in the hangar and as a line in battle.

platoon_helper.title: Platoon helper
platoon_helper.text: Who in the platoon pressed “Ready”, and your platoon battles this session.

comp7_helper.title: Onslaught divisions
comp7_helper.text: Your rating, division, points to the next one and the Champion and Legend thresholds.

event_trackers.title: Event trackers
event_trackers.text: The Triathlon round and the Trading Caravan tokens while the event runs.

tilt_guard.title: Tilt guard
tilt_guard.text: Suggests a break after a losing streak or a long session.

marks_panel.title: Marks in battle
marks_panel.text: The percentage at the start and the forecast after, damage to 65, 85 and 95 % and battles to the next mark.

hangar_marks.title: Marks in the hangar
hangar_marks.text: For the selected tank: the percentage, damage per battle to each mark and a forecast at your pace.

marks_history.title: Marks history
marks_history.text: The percentage after every battle, the trend and the date of each mark.

hangar_ratings.title: My ratings
hangar_ratings.text: WN8, EFF, Bronya Index and average damage from the site — per account, session and tank.

session_stats.title: Session in the hangar
session_stats.text: Battles, win rate, average damage and WN8 for the session, with a strip of the last 10 battles.

battle_results.title: Battle results
battle_results.text: A summary after every battle: damage, assist, economy after repairs, shots and marks.

battle_efficiency.title: Battle efficiency
battle_efficiency.text: This battle's WN8 and your damage against your own average on the tank.

main_gun.title: High Caliber
main_gun.text: How much damage you still need for the medal, and when it is out of reach.

session_goals.title: Goals from the site
session_goals.text: Goals from your account: progress in the hangar, a line in battle and a sound when one is done.

replay_manager.title: Replay manager
replay_manager.text: All your replays with map, tank and result: search, filters, playback from the hangar and upload to the site.

replay_upload.title: Replay auto-upload
replay_upload.text: Uploads the replays of your battles to the site. Off until you turn it on.

streamer_mode.title: Streamer mode
streamer_mode.text: A key hides every mod panel for OBS scenes; the private mode hides the chat and your numbers.

battle_clock.title: Clock
battle_clock.text: The time of day in battle and in the hangar, optionally in place of the battle timer.

personal_best.title: Personal best
personal_best.text: Your damage record on the tank during the battle, and a card with a sound when you beat it.

fairPlay.title: Fair play
fairPlay.lead: Lesta punishes mods that reveal enemies, help aiming or change vehicle stats. The modpack has none of that and never will: the manager says what each component reads.

reads.results: The personal block of your battle results
reads.dossier: Your tanks' dossier: marks and average damage
reads.feedback: Your damage and assist — the same events the stock log shows
reads.loadout: Your tank's equipment, consumables and crew in the hangar

never.enemies: Shows no enemies or spotting beyond the client
never.aim: Gives no aiming, dispersion or lead hints
never.stats: Changes no vehicle stats and no object transparency
never.others: Sends no other players' data from battle results

bans.label: accounts
bans.text: Lesta blocked for forbidden mods in a single month.

install.title: How to install
install.lead: Three steps. The manager does the rest.

download.title: Download the manager
download.text: An installer for Windows 10 and 11. It has no code-signing certificate yet, so Windows may warn you: click “More info” → “Run anyway”.

pick.title: Pick a set
pick.text: The manager finds Mir Tankov by itself. Take a ready-made set or tick the components by hand.

play.title: Install and play
play.text: The manager takes a backup before installing. The Three Marks window opens from a button in the bottom-right corner of the hangar.

install.restart: On the first start the game may restart once — that is how the OpenWG Gameface library hooks up the mod window.

bind.title: Bind the mod to the site
bind.text: Unbound, the mod works in the game but sends nothing. Once bound, your battles, marks and sessions show up on the site, and your ratings and goals in the hangar. The code is single-use; bound computers are listed in your account.

manager.hint: Nothing opened? <link>Install the Three Marks manager</link> and click again.

managerApp.title: A manager, not an installer
managerApp.lead: It stays with you after the install: it turns components on and off without reinstalling and keeps an eye on patches.

sets.title: Sets and builds
sets.text: Three ready-made sets and up to 12 of your own. Share them as a code or a file.

profiles.title: Settings profiles
profiles.text: Your panel settings in a profile: save, switch, send to a friend as a code or a link.

sync.title: Sync with the site
sync.text: Sets and profiles are kept on the site, so a new computer does not lose them. Syncs on a button.

patches.title: Updates after a patch
patches.text: A patch is out — the manager moves the modpack to the new folder or installs a compatible version as soon as it is out.

backups.title: Backups and rollback
backups.text: A snapshot before every update and a one-click rollback.

conflicts.title: Conflict check
conflicts.text: Finds XVM, PMOD and other mods that duplicate your components and shows what overlaps.

perf.title: FPS cost
perf.text: Every component shows how much it loads the game, with a “Light only” filter.

report.title: Report a problem
report.text: Collects the logs, hides anything personal and sends them to us. You see every file before sending.

switches.title: What goes to the site
switches.lead: Only your own account's events, signed with the device key, and only after binding. Each item turns off in the mod window.

battleResults.title: Battle results
battleResults.text: Map, mode, result, your tank, damage, assist, spotting, kills, XP, credits, the marks after the battle and your platoon.

moeSnapshots.title: Marks in the hangar
moeSnapshots.text: The selected tank's percentage and average damage — only when they change.

queueTimes.title: Queue time
queueTimes.text: How long you waited for a battle and on which tank.

loadouts.title: Tank loadout
loadouts.text: Equipment, consumables, directives, shells, field modification and crew skills — for the build stats.

shots.title: Your hits
shots.text: Damage and result of your shots at enemies, without positions or distances — for “Honest RNG”.

shareSettings.title: Game settings
shareSettings.text: Graphics, camera, reticle and sound — only when you press “Send to the site” yourself. Login, hardware and mods never go.

replays.title: Replays
replays.text: Your replays the game recorded. Only you see them until you turn publishing on.

flush.title: Send interval
flush.text: How often the mod sends the queued events from the hangar.

idle.title: Session end
idle.text: Minutes without battles after which a new session starts.

changelog.title: What's new
changelog.lead: The latest modpack releases. The full history is in the manager: “Help” → “What's new”.
changelog.empty: The change history appears with the first release.
changelog.errorTitle: Could not load the change history

ban.question: Can the modpack get me banned?
ban.answer: Bans are for mods that reveal enemies, help aiming or change vehicle stats. The modpack has none of that: its components work with your own data and with what the client already shows. It is being prepared for MOST, Lesta's official mod portal.

free.question: How much is it?
free.answer: Nothing. Every component is free, there are no ads, and the modpack does not need a Plus subscription.

patch.question: What happens after a patch?
patch.answer: The manager notices the new client version. If the modpack is compatible, it moves it to the new folder by itself. If a new version is needed, it installs it as soon as it is out, taking a backup first.

conflicts.question: Can I run it with XVM, PMOD or another modpack?
conflicts.answer: Yes, but the same panels will show twice. The manager checks the mods folder and shows which mods overlap your components — turn off the extra ones on our side or theirs. It removes other mods' files only when you confirm, and after a backup.

perf.question: Will it cost me FPS?
perf.answer: Most components react to events and barely load the game. The ones that work every frame are marked in the manager. For a weak PC there is the “Minimal (FPS)” set: only the marks in battle, the lamp and the clean hangar.

remove.question: How do I remove the modpack?
remove.answer: In the manager: “Settings” → “Backups” → remove the modpack from the client, optionally rolling back to the last backup and deleting the settings. When you uninstall the manager itself, Windows asks whether to remove the modpack too. Other mods stay where they are.

bind.question: Why bind the mod to the site?
bind.answer: Unbound, the mod works in the game but sends nothing. Once bound, your battles, marks and sessions show up on the site, and your ratings and goals in the hangar. Get a new code in your account; old computers are unbound there too.

replays.question: Does the mod upload replays?
replays.answer: Only if you turn on auto-upload in the mod window — it is off by default, and only you see the uploaded replays until you turn publishing on. You can also upload a replay by hand.

delete.question: How do I delete my data?
delete.answer: Unbind the device and request an export or deletion of your data in your account.

cta.title: Try it in your next battle
cta.text: The manager is free, components turn off one by one, and the modpack comes off as easily as it goes on.

meta.title: Three Marks modpack profile
meta.description: Open a modpack settings profile in the Three Marks manager or add it by code in the game.

profile.title: Modpack profile
profile.description: Someone shared a modpack settings profile with you: which components are on and how they are set up.
profile.managerNote: The manager opens “Profiles” with this code; you only confirm the import.
profile.gameNote: Without the manager: copy the code and paste it in the game — the mod window, “Profiles”, “Add from code”.
profile.missingTitle: The link has no profile code
profile.missingDescription: The link is cut off or outdated. Ask for a new one, or paste the code into the manager by hand: “Profiles” → “Import a code”.
